title: C++: Observable Stream
description: Create an observable data stream with map and filter operators.

steps.title: Observable Stream
steps.description: Create a Stream class with a vector<int> source. Implement map(function<int(int)>) that returns a new Stream with transformed values, and filter(function<bool(int)>) that returns a new Stream with only matching values. Chain: array(1-5) -> map(x2) -> filter(>5) -> collect.
hints: Stream map(function<int(int)> fn) { vector<int> result; for (int x : data) result.push_back(fn(x)); return Stream(result); }
Each operation returns a new Stream (immutable).
